module: Small loader that loads or unloads the freeroam_crashCamMode extension (slow-motion camera after a crash) according to the enableCrashCam setting. It avoids leaving the crash camera active when the player disables it in the options.
notes: On unload, the `elseif freeroam_crashCamMode` test relies on the extension's global: it is only unloaded if it is already loaded.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension loads: loads freeroam_crashCamMode if the enableCrashCam setting is true.

onSettingsChanged.desc: Hook called when the settings change: loads freeroam_crashCamMode if enableCrashCam is true, otherwise unloads it if it is loaded.
